title: CONNECT-IP HTTP/1.1 Upgrade Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 HTTP/1.1 upgrade policy.
scope: This verification covers the HTTP/1.1 GET method, single Host field, Connection: Upgrade, Upgrade: connect-ip, malformed 400 recommendation, 101 response, response upgrade fields, no-content Capsule requirements, and failed-attempt connection-close decision.
preconditions: RFC 9484 request and tunnel setup policies are trace-owned.
expected_result: The focused HTTP/1.1 CONNECT-IP upgrade tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9484 HTTP/1.1 artifacts, generated triage reflects requirements 0042-0052 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9484 HTTP/1.1 upgrade policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
